description: This Java class defines a REST API route for the 'whoami' endpoint, providing information about the current user. It constructs an HTTP GET route at '/whoami' and extends an abstract route class, utilizing Akka HTTP DSL for routing.

classes.name: WhoamiRoute
classes.description: Defines an HTTP route at '/whoami' that responds with user information, extending an abstract route class for common routing functionalities.

methods.name: WhoamiRoute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the route with required dependencies including actor references, configuration objects, and header translator.

methods.name: buildWhoamiRoute
methods.description: Builds the Akka HTTP route for handling GET requests at the '/whoami' path.

methods.name: whoami
methods.description: Handles the specifics of the GET request, returning user information wrapped in a Route object.
